allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/enquiry" -Method GET -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 8; "STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)`nBODY: $\($r.Content\)" } catch { $resp = $_.Exception.Response; if \($resp\) { $code = [int]$resp.StatusCode; $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader\($resp.GetResponseStream\(\)\); $body = $reader.ReadToEnd\(\); "STATUS: $code`nBODY: $body" } else { "NO RESPONSE / server not running: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })
